source: orb.js v3.0.0 legacy Orb.SGP4 and Orb.Observation baseline
procedure: The fixed TLE was propagated with legacy Orb.SGP4. Legacy Orb.Observation azel elevation was sampled every 30 seconds, 10 degree crossings were refined by 40 bisections, and each culmination was refined by golden-section search. This fixture freezes the independent legacy observation path for structured-event regression; it is not an estimate of historical ISS truth.
timeScale: TLE epoch and event timestamps interpreted as UTC
frame: SGP4 TEME propagated with WGS-72, then legacy GMST/WGS-84 topocentric horizontal coordinates
center: Tokyo observer at geodetic latitude 35.658 degrees, longitude 139.741 degrees, height 0.025 km
accuracy: Regression oracle against a separately implemented legacy observation path using the same SGP4 lineage; not an independent real-orbit accuracy claim.
